title: Chrono Block
description: The Chrono Block is a mystical device that creates a time bubble
body: The Chrono Block is a mystical device that creates a time bubble in a 5-block radius when placed, significantly slowing down block updates like plant growth, leaf decay, and other scheduled events within its area of effect. Simply place the block in your world and it will automatically activate, emitting enchanted particles and a soft glow to indicate it's working. Right-click the placed block to toggle the time bubble on or off, allowing you to control when the temporal effects are active - perfect for preserving builds, controlling farm growth rates, or creating areas where time moves more slowly.
